Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick R Infinite Duress. Also get armor against the physical damage from his basic attacks. If the fight drags on and Warwick’s healing becomes a problem, apply Grievous Wounds with Executioner's Calling after you have resistance.
Warwick.combo: After the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl triggers, knock him up with Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! built up outside vision. Follow with three throws of Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage, then activate Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero to hold him with slows until the root triggers. If Warwick still has a movement ability, he can escape this combo, so check whether he has used it first.
Warwick.escape: The window to approach is after the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl triggers. If Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down, and especially before Warwick R Infinite Duress is available again, engage with Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage.
Warwick.fight: Don’t pour damage into Warwick while Warwick E Primal Howl is active; fight after the fear triggers. If only one of Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast and Warwick R Infinite Duress is down, he can escape with the remaining movement ability, so don’t rush your engage. Even at low health, his healing becomes stronger, so don’t chase deep based on his health alone.
Warwick.laning: If health drops below half, recall instead of staying exposed to Warwick W Blood Hunt.
Warwick.phase: Even late, Nunu & Willump handles engages and protects allies, but don’t go in alone.
Warwick.teamfight: From within range for your allies to follow up, engage with Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and chain Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage into Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero. If Warwick uses Warwick R Infinite Duress on an ally, focus your counterattack on Warwick while he’s bound there. If there’s no good angle to engage, activate Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero in front of your allied carry to stop Warwick from engaging.
Warwick.watch: Warwick R Infinite Duress dashes in from far away and suppresses Nunu & Willump, so keep even more distance when Warwick’s movement speed is increased. While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage and its fear will trigger, so back off and re-engage after the fear. When health drops below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your location and increases his movement and attack speed, so don’t linger.

XinZhao.build: Build armor first against Xin Zhao’s main damage. His damage relies on basic attacks and attack speed, so reducing his attack speed is also effective. If his slows are a problem, get slow resistance with Mercury's Treads and Unflinching.
XinZhao.combo: After Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down, roll Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! from outside vision and land the knockup. Follow with three throws of Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage, then use Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero to make use of its slow and shield while holding him until the root triggers. If Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard pushes your formation back or the target tries to leave the area of Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero, end Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero early to detonate it.
XinZhao.escape: When engaging, look for the moment just after you bait out Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Conversely, keep your distance if the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike is still available.
XinZhao.fight: If Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike catch you, it’s difficult to escape, so manage your distance early. Dodge the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving sideways, then engage with Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! after Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, create distance instead of forcing damage, then counterattack after it ends.
XinZhao.laning: Choose a lane where your allies can follow up instead of trying to secure a kill alone. After a gank, you can build up the snowball again by the Rift Scuttler and look for another engage.
XinZhao.phase: Late game, Nunu & Willump handles engages and protects allies, then counterattacks the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.teamfight: Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s knockback can split your formation, so don’t stand too close to your allies. Engage with Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! when your allies can follow up, and look for the root from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage if Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down. If there’s no good angle to engage, activate Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero in front of your allied carry to stop Xin Zhao from engaging.
XinZhao.watch: Dodge the thrust at the end of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving sideways. If you’re hit by the thrust, Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge can reach you from farther away. If you’ve been hit twice by Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike’s empowered attacks, use Flash to create distance before the third hit knocks you up.
